e-207.worked_solution:
The formula for the derivative of $\textrm{arccot}$ is

$$
\dfrac{\textrm d}{\textrm d x}(\textrm {arccot } x) 	=  -\dfrac 1 {1+x^2}.
$$

Using the formula above, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(2\,\text{arccot }x) \\  & =2\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\text{arccot }x) \\  & =2\cdot (-\frac{1}{1+{x}^{2}}) \\  & =-\frac{2}{1+{x}^{2}}.\end{aligned}
$$

before.html:
Question 1
?

Calculate f′(x) if f(x)=x−2arccscx.

a
1x−12|x|x2−1
b
12x−1|x|x2−1
c
1x+2xx2−1
d
12x+2|x|x2−1
e
12x+12xx2−1
Submit

decision.explanation: The derivative of sqrt(x) is 1/(2sqrt(x)), and the derivative of arccsc(x) is -1/(|x|sqrt(x²-1)). Multiplying the latter by -2 gives a positive term, so option d is correct.

after.name: Question 1
after.worked_solution:
The formula for the derivative of $arccsc$ is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(arccscx)=-\frac{1}{|x|\sqrt{{x}^{2}-1}}.
$$

Using the formula above, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\sqrt{x}-2arccscx) \\  & =\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}-2\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(arccscx) \\  & =\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}-2(-\frac{1}{|x|\sqrt{{x}^{2}-1}}) \\  & =\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}+\frac{2}{|x|\sqrt{{x}^{2}-1}}.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 1
?

Calculate f′(x) if f(x)=x−2arccscx.

a
1x−12|x|x2−1
b
12x−1|x|x2−1
c
1x+2xx2−1
d
12x+2|x|x2−1
e
12x+12xx2−1
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

The formula for the derivative of arccsc is ddx(arccscx)=−1|x|x2−1.

Using the formula above, we obtain f′(x)=ddx(x−2arccscx)=12x−2⋅ddx(arccscx)=12x−2(−1|x|x2−1)=12x+2|x|x2−1.

verification.explanation: The revealed solution confirms that differentiating -2 arccsc(x) gives +2/(|x|sqrt(x²-1)). Adding the derivative of sqrt(x), 1/(2sqrt(x)), yields option d.

content.worked_solution:
The formula for the derivative of $arccsc$ is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(arccscx)=-\frac{1}{|x|\sqrt{{x}^{2}-1}}.
$$

Using the formula above, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\sqrt{x}-2arccscx) \\  & =\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}-2\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(arccscx) \\  & =\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}-2(-\frac{1}{|x|\sqrt{{x}^{2}-1}}) \\  & =\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}+\frac{2}{|x|\sqrt{{x}^{2}-1}}.\end{aligned}
$$

after.name: Question 2
after.worked_solution:
The formula for the derivative of $arccot$ is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(arccot\,x)=-\frac{1}{1+{x}^{2}}.
$$

Using the formula above, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}^{′}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(2x+arccotx) \\  & =2+(-\frac{1}{1+{x}^{2}}) \\  & =2-\frac{1}{1+{x}^{2}}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the slope $m$ of the tangent to the curve at $x=0$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}m={y}^{′}(0) & =2-\frac{1}{1+{0}^{2}} \\  & =2-1 \\  & =1.\end{aligned}
$$
